relationship_type.textual_place: The work explicitly names the real place.
relationship_type.inferred_place: The work gives evidence for a real place (alias, description) without naming it; the identification is a separate claim with its own status.
relationship_type.narrative_location: The story is meant to occur there. Also used for named or unnamed story locations whose real-world identity is unresolved.
relationship_type.biographical_place: The creator lived, worked, met someone or spent documented time there.
relationship_type.inspiration_place: A documented real place or event influenced the work.
relationship_type.composition_place: The work was written, painted or composed there.
relationship_type.filming_location: A film was physically shot there.
relationship_type.adaptation_location: A later adaptation used the place.

spatial_role_notes.marker: named for orientation or association; no scene occurs there
spatial_role_notes.projected_place: imagined, remembered, reported or figurative; characters are not present in the narrative now

mention_type.explicit_name: current or period name given in the text
mention_type.historic_name: name given in the text has since changed
mention_type.fictional_alias: the text uses an invented name for a real place
mention_type.named_venue_unidentified: a named venue whose real-world identity or address is not established
mention_type.unnamed: the place is described but not named
mention_type.figurative_allusion: the name is used as metaphor, not as a location of action

verification_status.verified: A primary text read directly in a legitimately accessed edition (for what the work says), or a Tier-1 institutional record that states the fact directly. Not the same as human-reviewed.
verification_status.strongly_supported: The author's own statement, or one Tier-1/2 secondary statement, or two independent Tier-3 statements, or an unreferenced structured record that matches by name and context.
verification_status.probable: A single Tier-3 source, or an inference by the researcher with the reasoning written down.
verification_status.unresolved: No adequate evidence; may be permanently unknowable.
verification_status.conflicting: Sources disagree; see the conflict record.
verification_status.editorial_interpretation: A reading, not a fact. None recorded in this phase.

source_tier.2: research project or open structured dataset
source_tier.4: weak discovery source — never sufficient alone

coord_precision.street: one representative point on a street
